name: luminary_co_website
description: A modern, single-page marketing website for Luminary Co., a Lusaka-based creative and media agency. Built with HTML, Tailwind CSS, and vanilla JavaScript for optimal performance and maintainability.

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run build:vercel
scripts.build:vercel: rm -rf public && mkdir public && cp -r assets css js index.html public/
